'''Aya Hisakawa''' (Japanese: '''久川 綾''' ''Hisakawa Aya'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hisakawa was born on November 12, 1968 in {{wp|Kaizuka, Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became an actress as an adult. She originally voiced [[Carol]] in the [[M02|second movie]] and [[Luna Carson]] in ''[[Mewtwo Returns]]'' before returning to the franchise nearly two decades later in ''[[Pokémon Masters EX]]''.
